entities.name: RLC-BearerConfig
entities.description: Configuration information for RLC bearers received in rlc-BearerToAddModList IE

entities.name: logicalChannelIdentity/LogicalChannelIdentityExt
entities.description: Identifier for logical channels within the same cell group

entities.name: DAPS bearer
entities.description: A bearer type that maintains both source and target connections during handover

entities.name: SRB bearer
entities.description: Signaling Radio Bearer used for control plane signaling

entities.name: RLC entity
entities.description: Radio Link Control entity responsible for data transfer reliability

entities.name: PDCP entity
entities.description: Packet Data Convergence Protocol entity identified by servedRadioBearer or servedMBS-RadioBearer

entities.name: Configured RLC bearer condition
entities.description: Condition where UE's current configuration contains an RLC bearer with the received logicalChannelIdentity within the same cell group

entities.name: New RLC bearer condition
entities.description: Condition where logical channel with given logicalChannelIdentity is not configured within the same cell group

entities.name: reestablishRLC condition
entities.description: Condition triggered when reestablishRLC is received, requiring RLC entity re-establishment

relations.description: RLC-BearerConfig triggers evaluation of whether RLC bearer with same logicalChannelIdentity exists
When RLC bearer exists, UE reconfigures RLC entity according to received rlc-Config
When RLC bearer exists, UE reconfigures logical channel according to received mac-LogicalChannelConfig
When reestablishRLC is received, UE re-establishes the RLC entity as specified in TS 38.322
When new RLC bearer is configured, UE establishes RLC entity according to rlc-Config or default configuration
When new RLC bearer is configured, UE configures MAC entity with logical channel according to mac-LogicalChannelConfig or default configuration
When new RLC bearer is configured, UE associates logical channel with PDCP entity identified by servedRadioBearer or servedMBS-RadioBearer
DAPS bearer configuration affects RLC bearer reconfiguration behavior
SRB bearer configuration affects RLC bearer reconfiguration behavior
